name: Quadriceps Stretch
description: Stretches the front of the thigh standing: hold one ankle and draw the heel up and back, a hand on a wall for balance.

source.title: Mayo Clinic: A guide to basic stretches

setup: Stand near a wall or sturdy support.
cues: Tighten your stomach so it doesn't sag forward.
Pull gently until you feel it in the front of the thigh.

prescription.note: Hold about 30 seconds and repeat 2 to 4 times on each side. Warm up for 5 to 10 minutes first, move slowly, don't bounce, and back off if it hurts.

keyframes.name: Hand on the wall
keyframes.cue: Stand tall with your left hand on the wall.

keyframes.name: Hold your ankle
keyframes.cue: Grasp your right ankle and draw the heel up and back.
